title: Product listing information
content: Product names, models, asking prices, categories, specifications, and public owner details come from the live ElectraStore catalog. The assistant uses catalog tools for current listing facts.

title: How ElectraStore works
content: ElectraStore is a non-transactional product-discovery marketplace. It does not provide a cart, checkout, payments, shipping, or order processing. Interested viewers contact a product owner directly using the public phone number and address on the listing.

title: Contacting a product owner
content: Every product detail page displays the owner's public name, phone number, address, and rating. ElectraStore does not participate in or guarantee arrangements made between viewers and owners.

title: Product likes
content: Signed-in viewers can like or unlike a product listing. Each account contributes at most one like to the displayed count.

title: Product comments
content: Anyone can read product comments. A signed-in viewer can publish a comment and can delete their own comment.

title: Sharing a listing
content: A product detail page can be shared through the device share sheet, WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram, X, or by copying its public link.

title: Viewer account privacy
content: The assistant can provide a minimal overview of the signed-in viewer account. It never exposes passwords or another person's private account data.
